# Verndly

> Verndly (https://verndly.com) is Ghana's marketplace connecting buyers with verified independent businesses, brands, and young entrepreneurs.

All purchases on Verndly are protected by Paystack escrow settlement, offering a 7-Day Buyer Protection guarantee and fast local courier delivery. Sellers pay a single flat 4% fee (Paystack Mobile Money and card processing included) and keep 96% of every sale, with zero buyer surcharges.

## Core Features
- **Flat 4% Seller Fee (Paystack Included)**: No 7–20% category commissions, no per-order seller shipping contribution, and GH₵ 0 setup or monthly fee on standard verified stores.
- **Verified Independent Merchants**: Curated stores operating in Greater Accra today and onboarding verified sellers across Ghana via Ghana Card + sales proof, existing store link, or direct review within 24–48 hours.
- **7-Day Escrow Buyer Protection**: Online payments via Paystack (MTN Mobile Money, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo Money, Visa, Mastercard) are held in escrow and only released to the seller after delivery and inspection.
- **Direct Storefronts**: Each verified seller operates an independent storefront accessible at `https://verndly.com/s/[store_link]`.
- **Seller-Configured Courier Delivery**: Delivery zones and dispatch windows are set by each verified merchant, including same-day Accra delivery and free Store Pickup where offered.

## Buyer Protection & Refunds
- **Inspection Period**: 7 calendar days from delivery confirmation.
- **Eligible Reasons**: Damaged in transit, defective, materially different model/color, or non-delivery.
- **Refund Execution**: Automated Paystack gateway reversal directly to original Mobile Money or card account within 24–48 hours.
- **Dispute Escalation**: Independent administrative arbitration if buyer and merchant do not reach agreement within 48 hours.
